status: committed before any series of this study is computed. The member list below was read from the already-published ADR 0092 catalog (no new computation).
honesty: S1 and S2 were already looked at for every member. Members are chosen on S1 numbers, so S1 is selection-biased; S2 has also been seen before. Post-hoc exploration on spent DEV data, not evidence. No prereg is activated, no window is opened.

rule_on_S1_rows: mean_net_bp > 0 and sr_ann > 0  (profit after the family's own cost row, i.e. '수익은 난다')
'수익이 많이 안 난다' is not used to exclude anything: no S1 row has sr_ann above 1.04, all below the chance maximum (2.49 at the cumulative trial count), so every positive row is 'small'
at least one loss metric recorded (worst_bp, max_dd_pct, liq_share)
every recorded loss metric small: worst_bp >= -2500 (worst trade/cycle no worse than -25%), max_dd_pct <= 20, liq_share <= 0.05
selection.dedupe: S-3f825ccdd41fb32d and S-bdae1ff0b24876cc have identical S1 and S2 numbers (same rule); keep S-3f825ccdd41fb32d only
selection.dropped_no_data: MAP-Elites S-f46972b73316b7a2, S-1df19a12439b25fd: BTC/ETH only, not in the project archive and the exchange is unreachable here. Reported as not run, not counted.

execution_model.principle: every order that can wait is a resting limit (maker) order: all entries, every profit-taking exit. Exits that cannot wait are market (taker) orders with full cost: stop-loss, liquidation, hard time cap. A limit order fills only when the price trades THROUGH it by FILL_MARGIN = 5 bp; the fill price is the limit itself (no improvement). Orders that do not fill are lost (entries) or stay resting (exits). This makes fills adverse-selected by construction (an entry fills only when price moves against it).

scalein.engine: ADR 0089 dca_stop_dev.simulate_stop semantics (17 alts daily, W 0.05, band 3%, 5x isolated, liquidation avg*(1-1/5+mmr), intra stops avg_intra / last_intra at x, cooldown 5, lookback 90), with ADR 0090 limit entries (first tranche: limit at the signal close, good for the next day only; adds: resting at L0*(1-s*k))
scalein.take_profit: resting limit at P_tp = max(avg*(1+0.10), P_be*(1+1bp)) for a long (mirror for a short), where P_be is the price at which the cycle's net (gross + funding - entry costs paid - maker exit cost, all at the conservative cost row) is zero. Active from the day after the last fill; not active on a day an add filled. Within a day, liquidation and stop are checked first: if either is touched the take-profit does not fill that day (conservative).
scalein.stop_and_liquidation: as ADR 0089, market fill with full (taker) cost
scalein.variant_CTRL: 60 days held -> market exit at the next open (taker), as the original
scalein.variant_RULE: 60 days held and not exited -> the take-profit limit is lowered to P_be*(1+1bp) (net > 0 only) and keeps resting; stop and liquidation stay active; hard cap 120 days held -> market exit at the next open (taker), reason CAP

r9.engine: ADR 0044 spec signal (build_spec_signal on closed bars), 15m bars, 7 symbols (BNB XRP SOL ADA DOGE LTC LINK), one position per symbol, no overlap (next signal only after the exit), funding from the archive (FundingIndex, settlements in (entry, exit]), per-side cost = CostContext.from_public_estimate(estimate_v3_alts).quote(ORDER_VALUE, previous bar traded value)
r9.entry: signal on bar t close -> limit at bar t+1 open, valid during bar t+1 only; fills if bar t+1 low <= open*(1-5bp) (long; short mirror); else the signal is lost (counted)
r9.variant_CTRL: exit at the open of bar entry+horizon, market (taker)
r9.variant_RULE: from bar entry+horizon a sell limit rests at P = max(open of bar entry+horizon, P_be*(1+1bp)) (long; short mirror), P_be from entry maker cost + maker exit cost + funding up to that bar at the conservative row; fills on the first bar whose high >= P*(1+5bp); if not filled by bar entry+2*horizon -> market exit at that bar's open (taker), reason CAP. No stop (the originals have none).
r9.booking: trade net booked on the exit day, basket average over the 7 symbols

cost_rows.decision_row: conservative (account fee tier UNKNOWN; ADR 0049: at maker fee 4bp the limit-order saving is 0)
cost_rows.breakeven_P_be_uses: conservative row in every cost row, so trade paths are identical across rows

execution_model.reference_runs_not_counted: the same members with market entries and original exits (reproduction of ADR 0089 / ADR 0092 numbers on this code path)

trials.breakdown: 27 members x 2 exit variants (CTRL, RULE) = 54; bundles ALL / R9 / SCALEIN x 2 variants = 6

bundle.construction: each member's daily net series (decision row) scaled to equal S1 daily volatility (scale computed on S1 only, applied unchanged to S2); bundle = equal-weight mean over members on the common day grid (days covered by both engines); the bundle is then scaled to 10% annual volatility on S1 (same factor on S2)
stats: share of RULE exits that ended at CAP

gate_bundle_DEV_PROMISING_all_of.a: S1 sr_ann (decision row) > expected maximum SR of N=60 independent trials, and the cumulative N is reported
gate_bundle_DEV_PROMISING_all_of.c: S1 and S2 close max drawdown <= 20% at the 10%-vol scale
gate_bundle_DEV_PROMISING_all_of.d: scale-in liquidation share <= 5% in S1 and S2, worst R9 trade >= -25% in S1 and S2
gate_bundle_DEV_PROMISING_all_of.e: central row S1 and S2 sr_ann > 0

member_report: per member and variant: S1/S2 trades, entry fill rate, hit rate, mean net bp, worst, sr_ann, exit reasons, CAP share; the RULE-vs-CTRL difference per member is descriptive only
decision_if_promising: nothing is activated; a DEV_PROMISING bundle would need a new prereg on an unseen window and VERIFIED cost before anything else
